en.title: KV Store with Nested Transactions
en.description:
Implement SET/GET/DELETE and nested BEGIN/ROLLBACK/COMMIT; GET on a missing key gives NULL; committing or rolling back with no transaction outputs NO TRANSACTION.

See "Input" for the standard I/O conventions and constraints added by this site.
en.input: q≤200000 lines; keys and values contain no spaces.
en.output: Output the GET results and the no-transaction errors.
en.explanation: Each transaction layer records key changes, and GET searches from the innermost layer outward; commit merges this layer's overrides into the parent layer, and rollback discards this layer.
